testcase.name: a rotate-90 tag reads as a 90 degree clockwise turn
turning a 40x20 bitmap by 90 or 270 swaps its dimensions, by 0 or 180 keeps them
reading the orientation does not modify the file
all eight defined values map, and the mirrored four say so
NORMAL returns the same bitmap and recycles nothing, any other orientation recycles the source
no tag, an undefined tag, an unknown value, and a non-JPEG all display unrotated
